verdict.rationale: Community reports say Brave's free-tier Terms of Use prohibit using responses for AI inference and that a separate AI plan exists for that use. That points to some documented permitted-use terms, though only second-hand and not from first-party docs in the pack. Nothing in the evidence covers robots.txt handling or content licensing of the indexed or pre-extracted content. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of permitted-use and storage rights, a robots.txt crawling stance, a content-licensing or attribution policy, and clear per-plan usage rights.
